correctness.rationale: For exactly 2k voters and path-edge candidate supports, 2k incidences imply PAV=2k-a/2. Locally nonimprovable words forbid runs 111, empty zero neighborhoods, 1100, 0011 and boundary 011/110; a extra zeros can be charged injectively in aggregate to s singleton selected runs, giving a<=s and k=2a+s>=3a. The explicit (110)^q(100)^q final-zero-deleted family extended by (10)^t attains a=floor(k/3) and has no improving swap. Exact standalone finite enumeration for k<=10 agrees; not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Addresses the recently studied quality of local PAV on a currently tractable VI family by computing its exact nontrivial finite-k price for every k. The proven 11/12 asymptotic loss and linear absolute score gap distinguish local improvement from exact optimization even when every candidate has two consecutive supporters; complete sharpness and all-k classification exceed an isolated negative example.
